description: This file defines the TwigFunction class, which represents a template function in the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for constructing the function, retrieving its type, parser callable, and safe context.

classes.name: Twig inal class TwigFunction
classes.description: Represents a template function in Twig, allowing configuration of safety, parser, and callable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TwigFunction with a name, optional callable, and options.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'function' indicating the type of this callable.

methods.name: getParserCallable
methods.description: Retrieves the parser callable if defined in options.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Returns safety information for the function, based on options and provided function arguments.
